name: Deep Sea Treasure
tagline: Dive for pearls, sharks and sunken diamonds.
featureText: A 🔱 that lands grows to fill its whole reel.

freeSpins.name: Rising Tide Free Spins
freeSpins.text: Wins start at ×1 and the multiplier rises by 1 after every winning free spin (up to ×10).

bonus.name: Ship's Wheel
bonus.text: Spin the ship's wheel for a prize of up to 100× your bet.

jackpot.name: Magic Oyster
jackpot.text: When a 🦪 Magic Oyster lands, open clams until three match: MINOR, MAJOR or GRAND. The bigger your bet, the better your chance.

collector.name: Treasure Chest
collector.text: Every 🪙 that lands goes into the Treasure Chest, shared by all players. The spin that fills the chest opens it: Treasure Hold & Win.

reward.name: Treasure Hold & Win
reward.text: 6 pearls lock in place and 3 respins start. Every new pearl sticks and resets the respins to 3. Each pearl pays its value.
